text.en: Mitosis and the cell cycle are the same thing -- in reality, mitosis is only one part of the cell cycle (the phase where the duplicated chromosomes are actually divided into two nuclei); most of a typical cell cycle's time is actually spent in interphase (G1, S, G2), which includes the cell's growth and the DNA replication that has to happen before mitosis can even begin.
text.et: Mitoos ja rakutsükkel on sama asi -- tegelikult on mitoos ainult üks osa rakutsüklist (etapp, kus kahekordistunud kromosoomid tegelikult jagatakse kaheks tuumaks); tüüpilise rakutsükli enamik aega kulub tegelikult interfaasile (G1, S, G2), mis hõlmab raku kasvu ning DNA replikatsiooni, mis peab toimuma enne, kui mitoos üldse saab alata.
